name: neutral-two-turn-luna-control
hypothesis: A minimally directed Luna session provides the appropriate control for measuring whether a specialized translation workflow adds value.
activation_condition: Use this neutral method for every assigned language and all three tasks.
fallback: When the supplied evidence is inconclusive, use ordinary translation judgment grounded in the exact examples.
falsifier: This control is unsuitable if it receives different data, model access, task items, turns, or output requirements from the experimental harness.
agent_instructions: Use only the supplied project files and examples. Complete the required research phase economically, then translate in the continuation turn. Do not adopt a prescribed linguistic framework, verifier panel, special tool, or multi-draft procedure.
research_prompt: Read the three task sources and the supplied exact examples. Inspect other supplied corpus rows only when naturally useful. Write the required .runner/evidence.json as concise free-form notes, without drafting the final translations and without imposing a specialized analysis scheme.
translation_prompt: Translate all three assigned verses using the supplied evidence and ordinary judgment. Return only the controller-required structured JSON.
